title: 설압자 저항 운동
instruction: 전문가 지도 아래 설압자로 앞·좌·우 방향에 가벼운 저항을 주세요.
caption: 전문가 지도 아래 가벼운 저항 운동을 하세요.
motion_prompt: Clinical supervision demonstration only. Show a stationary flat tongue depressor outside the lips providing very light resistance while the tongue presses forward, then gently to each side. No force, no deep insertion, no self-use gesture.
face_animation_policy: 중립·목표·복귀의 얼굴 전체 자세를 먼저 설계한다. 운동에 필요한 턱·볼·입꼬리·턱선을 함께 연동하고 선화·명암·질감을 맞춘다. 정지 얼굴 위에 입 도형만 교체하는 방식은 사용하지 않는다. 혀 독립 운동의 턱 안정은 해당 운동 의도를 따른다.
poses: mouth comfortably open with single tongue slightly protruded; a gloved clinician hand holds a flat tongue depressor OUTSIDE lips, ready without contact
tongue gently presses FORWARD against the flat tongue depressor held by a gloved clinician OUTSIDE lips; no deep insertion, no strain
tongue gently presses toward VIEWER-LEFT against a flat tongue depressor held at its left edge by clinician hand OUTSIDE lips; head and jaw stable
tongue gently presses toward VIEWER-RIGHT against a flat tongue depressor held at its right edge by clinician hand OUTSIDE lips; head and jaw stable
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Animation keyframe atlas for tongue_08_resistance. EXACTLY 2 columns and 2 rows of equal rectangular 16:9 tiles, edge-to-edge, NO gaps, NO borders, NO labels. Overall aspect ratio 32:18. Read tiles row-major left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each tile contains ONE complete scene, not multiple views. Use the attached adult Korean female illustrated therapist as the exact character and style reference. Same face, dark ponytail, white uniform, warm clinic background. Same front-facing head-and-shoulders framing in every tile, mouth and whole jaw clearly visible, same scale and head position, calm gaze. Render each WHOLE face as coherent artwork, including coordinated lip corners, cheeks, jaw, chin and natural linework, texture and shadows. No separately pasted vector mouth. Head/camera stable; jaw moves naturally for lip shapes, remains stable for independent tongue exercises. Clinician-supervised illustrative demonstration. Include only one gloved clinician hand and its flat tongue depressor, outside the lips, never deep insertion, never a self-use gesture. Keep face and working area unobstructed. Tile poses: TILE 1: mouth comfortably open with single tongue slightly protruded; a gloved clinician hand holds a flat tongue depressor OUTSIDE lips, ready without contact. TILE 2: tongue gently presses FORWARD against the flat tongue depressor held by a gloved clinician OUTSIDE lips; no deep insertion, no strain. TILE 3: tongue gently presses toward VIEWER-LEFT against a flat tongue depressor held at its left edge by clinician hand OUTSIDE lips; head and jaw stable. TILE 4: tongue gently presses toward VIEWER-RIGHT against a flat tongue depressor held at its right edge by clinician hand OUTSIDE lips; head and jaw stable. Crucial: each pose must differ by the REQUESTED movement, not random expression. One tongue only, no extra teeth, no detached lips, no camera cuts, no text, numbers, arrows, captions, logos, watermark or UI.
revised_prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create an illustration atlas for an adult speech-language pathology clinician training manual. Show ONLY a stylized synthetic dental teaching mannequin model made of matte plastic, not a real person, no face, no neck, no skin, no body or hands. A hinged dental model with upper and lower teeth and a single synthetic pink tongue. A small flat wooden tongue depressor with rounded tip is held OUTSIDE the front tooth opening by a visible mechanical handle, gently contacting only the anterior tongue. Exactly FOUR equally sized 16:9 panels in a TWO by TWO grid, edge-to-edge, no labels or borders, overall16:9. Same frontal slightly top-down model view, fixed jaw, ivory teeth, pale ivory studio background, clean calm textbook style. TOP LEFT: tongue at center, depressor just in front without contact. TOP RIGHT: tongue at center gently contacting the depressor in front. BOTTOM LEFT: tongue tip bends gently toward viewer-left to meet a depressor positioned on that side, still outside the model. BOTTOM RIGHT: tongue tip bends toward viewer-right to meet a depressor positioned on that side, still outside the model. Clearly educational rehabilitation model; no force, no deep insertion, no saliva, no gore, no arrows, no text, no logos. One tongue only. Geometry and camera identical across panels.
generation_note: Initial person/hand clinical illustration was rejected by image generation; final uses a synthetic teaching model.
